title: Protocol for mitochondrial isolation and sub-cellular localization assay for mitochondrial proteins
protocol: Obtain cultured cells from several 100 cm² cell culture dishes with approximately 80% density of cells, according to the aforementioned corresponding steps to collect the crude mitochondrial fraction.
Resuspend the crude mitochondria fraction obtained in step 1 in 150 μL of 1 × TD and collect in a 1.5 mL precooled tube.
Set the power of the ultrasonic homogenizer to 150 W and amplitude to 30%.
Homogenize samples on ice for 1 minute with a pause of 1 second every 1.5 seconds.
Wash the probe of the ultrasonic homogenizer with 15 mL of 75% ethanol followed by water at high pressure before each use.
Place the 1.5 mL tube containing mitochondrial suspension on ice.
Sonicate the mitochondrial suspension using the prepared ultrasonic homogenizer on ice to prevent overheating and avoid foam formation.
Transfer the sonicated suspension to a special centrifuge tube suitable for an ultra-speed Type 42.2 Ti Rotor.
Centrifuge at 75,000 × g in a Beckman Coulter Optima XPN-100 ultracentrifuge at 4°C for 40 minutes.
Collect the supernatant from the centrifuged sample into a fresh 1.5 mL tube.
Use 100 μL 1 × TD to gently rinse off the remaining supernatant from the surface of the pellet.
Centrifuge at 20,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C and pipette off the supernatant.
Gently add 1 × TD against the wall to avoid dispersing the pellet.
In case of accidental dispersion and resuspension of the pellet into the supernatant, centrifuge further to maximize the purity of the pellet.
Repeat step three times in total.
Fully resuspend the pellet (P) in 20 μL of 1 × TD.
Identify the concentration of the supernatant (S) and pellet (P) using the Pierce BCA Protein Assay Kit.
Prepare the sample for the Western blot.

Obtain cultured cells from several 100 cm² cell culture dishes with approximately 80% density of cells, according to the aforementioned corresponding steps to collect the crude mitochondrial fraction.
Resuspend crude mitochondrial fraction obtained in step 10 in 30 μL of Na₂CO₃ (100 mM).
Incubate on ice for 30 min. After 1 μL of PMSF (100 mM) is added, mix the sample well.
Transfer the suspension to the special centrifuge tube of the ultra-speed Type 42.2 Ti Rotor and centrifuge for 40 min at 75,000 × g.
Spin samples in Beckman Coulter Optima XPN-100 ultracentrifuge at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant (S) in a fresh 1.5 mL tube.
Gently wash away the supernatant left on the surface of the pellet using 100 μL 1 × TD.
Centrifuge at 20,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Repeat step twice for a total of three times.
Thoroughly resuspend the pellet (P) in 20 μl of 1 × TD.
Identify the concentration of the supernatant (S) and pellet (P) using the Pierce BCA Protein Assay Kit.
Prepare the sample for Western blot.
Add proteinase K to digest outer membrane proteins.
Dissolve mitochondrial membranes with Triton X-100 to allow proteinase K to pass through all compartments.
Obtain cultured cells from several 100 cm² cell culture dishes with approximately 80% density of cells.
Fully resuspend crude mitochondrial fraction obtained in step 19 in 120 μL of 1 × TD and equally divide them into four samples.
Add 3.33 μL of proteinase K solution (1 mg/mL) to the first sample, adding 10 μg of proteinase K per mg of mitochondrial protein.
Add 3.33 μL of 20% Triton X-100 to the second sample, adding 2 mg of Triton X-100 per mg of mitochondrial protein.
Mix 3.33 μL of proteinase K solution (1 mg/mL) and 3.33 μL of 20% Triton X-100 in the third sample.
Use the fourth sample as a blank control without adding any reagents.
Store the four samples at room temperature for 1 hour, mixing them well every 5 minutes with a pipette.
Add 1 μL of 100 mM PMSF into the four samples and mix well.
